BERNOULLI AND EULER POLYNOMIALS, RIEMANN ZETA FUNCTION (p.806)
23.1.22  [left] B_n(\tfrac14)=(-1)^nB_n(\tfrac34)=-2^{-n}(1-2^{1-n})B_n-n4^{-n}E_{n-1}\quad n=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] E_{2n-1}(\tfrac13)=-E_{2n-1}(\tfrac23)=-(2n)^{-1}(1-3^{1-2n})(2^{2n}-1)B_{2n}\quad n=1,2,\ldots
23.1.23  B_{2n}(\tfrac13)=B_{2n}(\tfrac23)=-2^{-1}(1-3^{1-2n})B_{2n}\quad n=0,1,\ldots
23.1.24  B_{2n}(\tfrac16)=B_{2n}(\tfrac56)=2^{-1}(1-2^{1-2n})(1-3^{1-2n})B_{2n}\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Symbolic Operations
23.1.25  [left] p(B(x)+1)-p(B(x))=p'(x)   |   [right] p(E(x)+1)+p(E(x))=2p(x)
23.1.26  [left] B_n(x+h)=(B(x)+h)^n\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(x+h)=(E(x)+h)^n\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Here p(x) denotes a polynomial in x and after expanding we set {B(x)}^n=B_n(x) and {E(x)}^n=E_n(x).
Relations Between the Polynomials
23.1.27  E_{n-1}(x)=\dfrac{2^n}{n}\Big\{B_n\Big(\dfrac{x+1}{2}\Big)-B_n\Big(\dfrac{x}{2}\Big)\Big\}=\dfrac2n\Big\{B_n(x)-2^nB_n\Big(\dfrac{x}{2}\Big)\Big\}\quad n=1,2,\ldots
23.1.28  E_{n-2}(x)=2\dbinom{n}{2}^{-1}\sum_{k=0}^{n-2}\dbinom nk(2^{n-k}-1)B_{n-k}B_k(x)\quad n=2,3,\ldots
23.1.29  B_n(x)=2^{-n}\sum_{k=0}^n\dbinom nk B_{n-k}E_k(2x)\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Euler-Maclaurin Formulas
Let F(x) have its first 2n derivatives continuous on an interval (a,b). Divide the interval into m equal parts and let h=(b-a)/m. Then for some theta, 1>theta>0, depending on F^{(2n)}(x) on (a,b), we have
23.1.30  \sum_{k=0}^m F(a+kh)=\dfrac1h\int_a^bF(t)dt+\dfrac12\{F(b)+F(a)\}+\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}\dfrac{h^{2k-1}}{(2k)!}B_{2k}\{F^{(2k-1)}(b)-F^{(2k-1)}(a)\}+\dfrac{h^{2n}}{(2n)!}B_{2n}\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}F^{(2n)}(a+kh+\theta h)
Equivalent to this is
23.1.31  \dfrac1h\int_x^{x+h}F(t)dt=\dfrac12\{F(x+h)+F(x)\}-\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}\dfrac{h^{2k-1}}{(2k)!}B_{2k}\{F^{(2k-1)}(x+h)-F^{(2k-1)}(x)\}-\dfrac{h^{2n}}{(2n)!}B_{2n}F^{(2n)}(x+\theta h)\qquad b-h\ge x\ge a
Let \hat B_n(x)=B_n(x-[x]). The Euler Summation Formula is
23.1.32  \sum_{k=0}^{m-1}F(a+kh+\omega h)=\dfrac1h\int_a^bF(t)dt+\sum_{k=1}^p\dfrac{h^{k-1}}{k!}B_k(\omega)\{F^{(k-1)}(b)-F^{(k-1)}(a)\}-\dfrac{h^p}{p!}\int_0^1\hat B_p(\omega-t)\Big\{\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}F^{(p)}(a+kh+th)\Big\}dt\qquad p\le2n,\ 1\ge\omega\ge0
